page.layout: Two columns of index entries, left and right, with the letters B, C, D and E set as separate headings within them. A running head "INDEX." at the top. No page number, catchword or signature printed.
page.notes: Running head "INDEX." is printed at the top; no page number is printed. Column layout is read from the scan; line pairing across the two columns is approximate where entries sit at the same height. The page number of "Audiani" (12[?]) is doubtful: the final character is a worn, ligatured form. "Enthousiastæ, 23[?]" is doubtful: the page reference is partly obscured by a flourish. "Collitia-" appears to be the start of a hyphenated word whose continuation is not legible on this page. Some entries in the right column have heavy show-through from the reverse side, which was disregarded.
